values.note: $24 a night for a drive-in site without electric, $34 with electric, in both campgrounds. ReserveMN's prices for June 2027 nights.

fees.source: ReserveMN search/details for every unit of facilities 856 and 916, 2027-06-15 (non-electric 'Rate 24.00', electric 'Rate 34.00'), read 2026-11-11

note: Two drive-in campgrounds among old-growth pines on Coon-Sandwick Lake: Chase Point on a wooded point (61 sites, 36 electric; the pull-throughs are 50-68) and the Lodge campground 0.8 km north by the beach and boat access (25 sites, two electric). The RV fill station's hose has no threaded connection; the nearest threaded fill is Bigfork's municipal station. --Claude

Sites: DNR says 88 drive-in sites and 38 electric at Chase Point; ReserveMN lists 86 web-bookable drive-in units (36 electric at Chase Point, 2 at the Lodge). count written from the DNR page.

Waterfront: keep not waterfront. ReserveMN gives '.1 mile' or '.2 mile' to the lake for every unit. The nearest units (Chase Point 1E, 2E, 27E-32E, 47E-49E at about 47.7130,-93.5689) are about 35-40 m from the shore on imagery, but under continuous pine canopy with a loop lane between them and the water: a *view at most, unconfirmed under canopy. The Lodge units (centroid 47.72156,-93.56870) are likewise wooded.

Pin 47.71382,-93.56995 is ~45 m from the Chase Point unit centroid (47.71419,-93.56973): OK. Lodge campground centroid is 820 m north; both off the same park road, so not a split candidate (under ~1 km, no own entrance found).

Season group is manual (2026: Chase Point closes November 1, Lodge September 7) and was not touched. DNR seasonal update now: 'Campgrounds and lodging are now closed for the winter, and will reopen in the spring of 2027.' The ReserveMN grid would not return 2027 season dates.
